Place Value

Understand ones, tens, hundreds and thousands.

Understand the idea first

Place value tells us what a digit is worth because of where it sits in a number.

1. Read from the right

The first place is ones, then tens, hundreds and thousands.

2. Find the digit

In 3,482, the 4 is in the hundreds place, so its value is 400.

3. Build the number

3 thousands, 4 hundreds, 8 tens and 2 ones make 3,482.

Check yourself

Say each digit with its place name. This avoids treating place value as an addition problem.
